“Eighth Layer Soul Defense Treasure…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes were slightly fervent.

Among all treasures, Soul Defense Treasures were definitely the most precious kind.

The soul carries the life’s consciousness and True Spirit.

For a High-Rank Evolver, the destruction of the physical body doesn’t equate to death.

...

But if the soul has issues, it directly affects the consciousness and True Spirit.

Among the many treasures left by Ou Yin, the most precious was undoubtedly this one.

In fact, Lin Yuan had come across a Soul Defense Treasure before, one of the prizes for the champion of the Canglan Star tournament.

However, that Soul Defense Treasure was only Third or Fourth Rank, not on the same level as the Eighth Layer Soul Defense Treasure left by Ou Yin.

“Is it shaped like a water droplet?”

Lin Yuan took out that Soul Defense Treasure.

It was a sky-blue droplet the size of a thumb, and upon closer inspection, one could see faint cracks on the surface of the droplet.

“Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin had armor to defend his physical body and this Eighth Layer droplet to guard his soul, but he still died under a soul attack from the Black Abyss*Qingyu.”

“Even this Soul Droplet was nearly penetrated…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

While Soul Defense Treasures can protect the soul, it doesn’t mean they are infallible. Even an Eighth Layer Soul Defense Treasure has its protective limits.

If an attack surpasses this limit, the soul will be pierced through the treasure, attacking the soul directly.

“The Black Abyss*Qingyu had the power to break through the protection of an Eighth Layer Soul Defense Treasure at the Eighth Layer?”

Lin Yuan pondered.

An Eighth Layer Soul Defense Treasure is given this prefix because it can resist the majority of soul attacks at the Eighth Layer level.

“Those from Different Species…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

In the wars between the Human Civilization Alliance and Different Species, humans have the upper hand, but this advantage is just that—merely an advantage. There are still many strong humans who die.

Black Abyss*Qingyu was just one member of the formidable Heiyuan Clan. If it were on the battlefields where humans are fighting against the Insect Race and other Peak Clans, the casualties on the human side would only be greater.

“This droplet is damaged…”

Lin Yuan touched the sky-blue droplet.

Despite the damage, it was still an Eighth Layer Soul Defense Treasure. If Lin Yuan wished, he could easily trade it for four or five pieces of Eighth Layer armor or similar weapons.

Most of Ou Yin’s wealth must have been spent on this defensive droplet.

“Find time to ask my mentor to see if it can be repaired.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, since it was broken, naturally it could be repaired, but fixing an Eighth Layer Soul Defense Treasure could only be possible if the Chikun Starlord had a way.

As for the risk of exposing that he had obtained Ou Yin’s legacy… what if it was exposed?

Ou Yin had been dead for over a million years and was a Lone Evolver. As a Peak Master of the Red Kun Lineage, who would dare to object?

Chikun Starlord, his mentor, was a strong figure from a million years ago, on par with Black Abyss*Qingyu. He probably wouldn’t be interested in a broken Soul Droplet.

…

“Special Life Bloodline Essence Potion…”

Lin Yuan took out a transparent test tube with a viscous purple liquid inside.

This kind of Special Life Bloodline Elixir didn’t serve much purpose to individual Evolvers. Its greatest effect was to implant the essence into the lineage of offspring.

This would then form a strong Evolver family.

Such a family would be much more powerful than the legacies left by Sixth Rank Fallen Star Warriors. This Special Life Bloodline Essence was purer, increasing both the probability and potential upper limits of awakening bloodlines in progeny.

“In the future, I could also use this Bloodline Evolution Elixir to create a powerful Evolver family as a force to cultivate…”

Lin Yuan had a plan.

Whether or not he decided to create his own Evolver family, if Lin Yuan wished to sell it, he could do so at any time.

After all, Special Lifes are rare, and this Bloodline Essence Potion, formed from countless Special Lifes, will only become scarcer over time.

…

In addition to the wealth and treasures inherited from Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin,

Lin Yuan had also gathered quite a bit from killing those Heiyuan Clan powerhouses.

But compared to Ou Yin, they were naturally far inferior. Those Heiyuan Clan members who dared to join the battlefield most likely left their main wealth and treasures at home.

The treasures they carried with them were not much, mostly just the weapons and equipment needed for battle.

“Upload the battle kill video.”

Lin Yuan directly uploaded the video of him killing those five Heiyuan Clan powerhouses to the Goddess of Freedom.

This was an important piece of evidence for the Goddess of Freedom to decide whether to grant Merit Points. The video recording function is unique to the three goddesses; outsiders cannot fake it or alter it.

And because the perspective of the video includes oneself, the possibility of killing fellow Evolvers from the same species, seizing their video, and pretending it shows one’s own kill is eliminated.

Drip—

“Video authenticity confirmed; facts confirmed. Upon evaluation, valued at 5,000 Merit Points…”

The voice of the Goddess of Freedom, imbued with cold murderous intent, resounded.

“5,000 Merit Points…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

5,000 Merit Points may seem like a lot,

but it’s not even enough to upgrade from a Level One Citizen to a Level Three Citizen.

It takes 1,000 Merit Points to go from Level One to Level Two,

and 5,000 Merit Points from Level Two to Level Three.

But these 5,000 Merit Points require the killing of five Sixth Layer Different Species members.

What concept is a Sixth Layer Different Species member? They are Fallen Star Warriors, and this time it was six at once.

“It’s still more worthwhile to focus on researching the Evolution Path.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that while killing these five members of the Heiyuan Clan went smoothly, doing it too frequently would cause problems.
